narrative.overview: The user-selected Timber Index extends the Regional Catalogue onto approved public discovery, comparison, accommodation detail and booking surfaces. It is an ordinary public extension, not a workspace redesign. All preceding workspace tokens and rules remain unchanged and authoritative for their original scope; public- tokens apply only inside the public shell.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled forest-green accommodation index and substantial regional illustration.
Warm date-search strip before the illustration on mobile.
Local display serif and supporting Arial.
Visible fictional-demo and image disclosures; prominent initial test-payment obligation.
dos: Keep Timber Index scoped to public pages.
Preserve the established workspace hierarchy, palette and controls.
donts: Do not replace the native policy disclosure with abbreviated policy text or preselect synthetic acknowledgements.

provenance.scope: Milestone 16 Phase B public extension only
provenance.authority: DESIGN.md public- frontmatter tokens and public extension sections
provenance.preservationReason: Explicit user boundary preserves existing stale workspace/Phase A Impeccable artifacts. This separate extension does not repair or claim freshness of those artifacts.
limitations: No automated region-map or comp-diff completion is claimed.
Original Phase A state intentionally preserved.
Snippets demonstrate implemented component patterns; illustrative payment amounts and complete policy text are not fabricated.
Existing CSS variables are scoped under .timber rather than :root, so panel snippets use literal observed CSS values.
